answer: Weight each attestation by how many independent, established peers sit between voter and target in the trust graph. A sybil farm looks like karst: a hollow network of caves all draining into one sinkhole, the single funding wallet. However many puppets climb that knoll and vouch for each other, their combined score never reaches the zenith, because few honest edges link them out. The attacker pays stake and compute for every fake, yet gains almost no voting weight.
